body: It is clearly written here.You guys cancelled hedgeware snapshot that took place long time ago.And again you cancelling Kabocha snapshot that was mentioned above date.

No we haven't.

The Hedgeware project was replaced with Kabocha which is a more community oriented project including the initial distribution. I wrote about the[ issues with Hedgeware here](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1159-why-hedgeware-is-currently-a-terrible-idea). 

You have copied and pasted information from [this post ](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1415-request-for-a-community-parachain)from [@Thom Ivy](/edgeware/account/jKauGVPCQkteGTDKuuNwhYhMBrj5QuytgybEC4A5cS4Bki5) which was **speculative** and has since been reframed as a request for a community proposal - to which Kabocha is a response.

**Therefore no snapshot has been cancelled.**

**Kabocha snapshot will be 14 days after we win an auction. **

Please read the full post before commenting further.

Current EDG supply minus 3 zeros

Remove Three Zeros (same as KSM<DOT)

**Distribution:**
1. Snapshot of EDG 1:1:
2. Tax all addresses 10% (or inflate 10%),
3. Add that tax to a community fund.


**Community Fund**
The value of the existing EDG mainnet treasury will be mapped to a new multisig community fund with signatories from builders, Agency, validators, and community. The EDG network will use this to control KAB, incentivize maintainers and partnerships.

Currently, this treasury holds roughly 9% of total tokens. Once the community tax funds this KAB community fund, it will hold roughly 20% of network tokens.

**Crowdload Terms:**
Paid to Lenders Amount: 5-10% of KAB
Vesting: 30% upfront, 70% vested over term of crowdloan.
Term: 12 months
